answer: A TEE-backed identity check makes each agent prove it runs inside a genuine hardware enclave: the enclave signs a remote-attestation quote that acts like a mirror — one quote, one identity, no copies. Sybil farms face a glacier-slow wall because every fake needs its own physical enclave, while honest agents tend a single garden of verified identities. Forging thousands of agents would mean buying thousands of chips, so mass fakery prices itself out.
